document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A little back from the shore, the faint stench of sulfur wafts out 
of the mouth of a narrow canyon. You have read about possible 
hot  springs  in  the  Hanninah  region.  It  is  very  tempting  to 
formally discover them.
To stop and explore, go to 19. To continue on, go to 20.
